definition: Defines approved hosting models and placement rules based on classification, criticality or risk.
Requires specified data to be stored or processed within a country, region or approved jurisdiction.
Establishes government-controlled, sovereign or accredited hosting with defined control and assurance conditions.
Addresses foreign lawful access, corporate control, subcontractors, administrative access or encryption-key custody.
Requires reversibility, data export, verified deletion and transition support when changing providers.
